aiAsistan.aciklama: A chat assistant you can embed on your website that answers visitors from your documents, site and FAQ. It doesn't make things up when it doesn't know — it hands the visitor over to your team.
aiAsistan.aciklamaYonetici: Set up the agency's own assistant and your clients' assistants, manage the knowledge base and test them in the panel. The agency assistant does not replace the existing site chat; visitors handed over become CRM leads.
aiAsistan.kopyalanamadi: Couldn't copy; select the text and copy it manually

liste.yeniAciklama: Each account has one assistant. Fill in the knowledge base first, then try it in the panel and embed it on your site.

kaynak.aciklama: The assistant answers only from the information here. Add FAQs, text, documents, web pages or imports from your modules.
kaynak.baslikIstege: Optional; the file or site name is used if empty.
kaynak.metinIpucu: Separating sections with "# Heading" lines makes answers more accurate.
kaynak.dosyaIpucu: {{turler}} · up to {{mb}} MB. Only the text is read; the file itself isn't stored.
kaynak.urlIpucu: A single page or the pages in the site's sitemap are read. Internal network addresses are rejected.
kaynak.robotsNotu: The site's robots.txt rules are respected; blocked pages aren't read.
kaynak.modulIpucu: Products, prices, event types and links are turned into text and added; reprocessing updates them.
kaynak.modulYok: You have no QR menu or booking page to import.
kaynak.silOnay: Delete the source "{{ad}}" and its chunks?
kaynak.bos: The knowledge base is empty. Add your first source; without sources the assistant answers "I don't know".

onizleme.aciklama: The same window your visitors will see. What you ask here is saved as a "preview".

ayar.karsilamaIpucu: If empty, a ready greeting is shown in the visitor's language.
ayar.dilIpucu: Automatic: replies in the language the visitor writes in.
ayar.esikIpucu: High: hands over on every question it isn't sure about. Low: tries to answer more questions.
ayar.sorularIpucu: One question per line (up to 6). Shown as buttons when the window opens.
ayar.yasakliIpucu: One topic per line; the assistant politely declines these topics.
ayar.mesaiIpucu: Outside business hours the handover form is shown as "leave us a message"; the assistant keeps answering.
ayar.saklamaIpucu: Conversations past this period (with handover details) are deleted automatically.
ayar.aydinlatmaBaglantisiIpucu: You are the data controller for conversations on your site; enter the link to your own privacy notice. If empty, our privacy page is shown.
ayar.aydinlatmaMetniIpucu: If empty, a short ready text is shown in the visitor's language.
ayar.aktif: Assistant is live (when off it doesn't open on sites; you can still test it in the panel)
ayar.hibritIpucu: After switching it on, "reprocess" your sources; vectors are computed then.
ayar.hibritYok: No embedding service configured; only lexical (BM25) search is used.
ayar.silOnay: Permanently delete the assistant "{{ad}}" together with its knowledge base and all conversations? The embed code will stop working.

gomme.kodAciklama: Paste this line right before your site's </body> tag. A chat bubble appears at the bottom right; clicking it opens the assistant.
gomme.kokenAciklama: The assistant opens only on these sites (subdomains included); embedded anywhere else it won't work. Leave empty to allow everywhere. One domain per line.
gomme.yenileAciklama: If someone else is misusing your embed code or link, regenerate the key. The old code stops working; you'll need to update the code on your site too.
gomme.yenileOnay: Regenerate the key? The old embed code on your sites and the shared link will stop working.
gomme.yenilendi: New key created; update your embed code

sohbet.sec: Select a conversation from the list to see the transcript.
sohbet.devirBaslik: The visitor asked to talk to a human
sohbet.anonim: This conversation was anonymised; contact details were deleted.
sohbet.anonimOnay: Delete the contact details and IP hash and mask e-mails and phone numbers in the messages? This can't be undone.

kullanim.dahilAlt: AI replies count; "I don't know" replies are free.
kullanim.blok: After the included replies, {{kredi}} credits per {{mesaj}} messages
kullanim.not: When the included replies and credits run out, the assistant stops answering and shows visitors a "leave us a message" form.
kullanim.notAjans: The agency assistant doesn't use credits; only the daily limit and the site's daily AI budget apply.

genel.aciklama: Model, the site's daily AI budget and the credits charged once the included replies run out.
genel.blokKrediIpucu: A multiple of 0.25; 0 = no credits charged.
genel.gommeHazir: An AI provider is configured; hybrid search can be enabled.
genel.gommeYok: No AI key is configured; hybrid search isn't available.

hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
hata.ag: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
hata.cok_hizli: Too fast; try again in a few seconds.
hata.https_gerekli: Enter an address starting with https://.
hata.asistan_var: This account already has an assistant.
hata.adres_yasak: This address can't be accessed (internal network or forbidden address).
hata.robots_engelli: The site's robots.txt rules block this page.
hata.tur_desteklenmiyor: This file type isn't supported (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD).
hata.dosya_buyuk: The file is too large (maximum {{en_cok_mb}} MB).
hata.dosya_bozuk: The file couldn't be read or is corrupted.
hata.dosya_sifreli: The file is password-protected; upload an unprotected copy.
hata.modul_kaydi_yok: Record not found or it doesn't belong to this account.
hata.modul_kapali: The AI assistant module is off for this account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You don't have permission for this.
hata.alan_adi_sayisi: You can add up to 20 domains.
hata.saat_gecersiz: Invalid business hours (the end must be after the start).
hata.islenemedi: The source couldn't be processed; try again.
hata.gorsel_buyuk: The image is too large (maximum {{en_cok_mb}} MB).
hata.gorsel_turu: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP images are allowed.
hata.oturum_gerekli: Your session has expired; please sign in again.
hata.hesap_uyesi_degil: You aren't a member of this account.
hata.ai_kapali: The AI service is currently unavailable.
